description: This Java class 'StatusWorker' provides static methods to retrieve status items and status validation details related to 'StatusItem' and 'StatusValidChangeToDetail' entities from a database, for use in JSP pages within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: StatusWorker
classes.description: A utility class with static methods to fetch status-related data from the database.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Retrieves a list of status items for a given status type ID and places it into the JSP page context with the specified attribute name.

methods.name: getStatusItems
methods.description: Overloaded method that retrieves status items for two status type IDs and combines them into one list in the page context.

methods.name: getStatusValidChangeToDetails
methods.description: Fetches valid status change details for a given status ID and sets it into the page context.
